method: per language over the frozen slices: rank id = sha256(domain|corpus|commit|path); at most `total` primary rows by the language exams' quota rule over corpora (each corpus first min(15, pool), the seats left by largest remainder), each corpus taking its lowest rank-domain hashes; the reserve is the audit-domain rank over the unpicked rest, at most `reserve` rows; a language with fewer than `whole_below` rows is taken whole with no reserve. Rows stored in audit-domain order.
